title: Spotlight guides and adaptive hints for quick console task completion
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Create a lightweight, discoverable set of interactive "spotlight" walkthroughs and adaptive inline hints that guide new and returning console users through high-value tasks (create project, configure a model route, view cost breakdowns, and set up a rollout). Success metrics: 20% reduction in time-to-complete first route setup for new users; 15% increase in users who view cost breakdown within 7 days; NPS improvement on onboarding flows by +6 points in qualitative tests. Scope: - Prototype two spotlight flows (Project creation -> Route -> Deploy; Route cost tuning -> Rollout configuration -> Monitor) - Design dismissible persistent coachmarks for key surfaces (Routes list, Cost panel, Rollouts page) - Create a template gallery micro UX for task-based starter templates (e.g., low-latency chat, batch embeddings) - Craft microcopy for hints, CTAs, and tooltip content with attention to clarity and actionability - Provide accessibility checklist and animation timing specs Out of scope: full localization rollout, backend instrumentation work (handled by ENG tickets), complex multi-step tutorials outside the two flows Deliverables: - Clickable Figma prototype (desktop + tablet) with annotated flows - Design spec document with interaction rules, animation timings, and accessibility notes - Copy deck for microcopy and tooltip variants - A/B test variants for “concise” vs “explained” hint styles - Handoff-ready tokens and example components for Frontend - Usability test plan and recruitment criteria Acceptance criteria: - Prototype validated in 6 moderated usability sessions with no critical usability issues reported - Edge-case states documented (user dismisses all hints, user returns after 30+ days) - Engineering signoff on implementable animations and state transitions
comments: 2025-02-06 Maya Chen: Kickoff — sketched three intent-based entry points for spotlight flows (create project, tune cost, rollout). Shared initial whiteboard and asked PM for priority tasks to land first prototype.

2025-02-10 Luca Moreno: Wireframes v1 uploaded to Figma. Chose compact spotlight overlay (single-element focus + short two-line hint). Need decision from PM on whether to auto-trigger cost hint on first route creation.

2025-02-12 Priya Rao (PM): Agreed to auto-trigger cost hint after first route creation for new tenants. Marked ENG-3312 to add event hooks. Also requested a variant where we surface a 'Try template' CTA in the spotlight.
2025-02-18 Accessibility review (quick): Reduced animation duration from 400ms -> 240ms and ensured focus trap exits cleanly. Added alt text for SVGs and keyboard flow notes.

2025-02-22 Research: Ran 8 unmoderated sessions. Observations: spotlight helped users find cost panel faster but some users ignored coachmarks when too wordy. Decision: create concise and expanded copy variants for A/B.

2025-02-26 Design critique: Feedback from Eng and PM — make coachmarks persist in collapsed sidebar state, allow 'Remind me later' option, and add analytics events table in spec. Luca to add interaction tokens and export components.

2025-03-01 Prototype update: Added template gallery micro-interactions and a quick 'apply template' flow. Linked example GitHub PR pattern: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/7681 for reference implementation.

2025-03-04 Maya Chen: Prepared usability test plan and recruited 10 participants (mix of ML engineers and product engineers). Next: run moderated sessions and incorporate findings, then freeze copy and microcopy variants for handoff on 2025-03-12.
